text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking alone down the hall, I spotted
Rice Shower looking rather melancholy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh.
What should I do... What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know... The weather forecast said
that it's going to pour tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice's race is coming up soon, though...
so she really wanted to get a lot of running in tomorrow...
choice_data_list: Let's rent out the gym and run there!
Let's make teru teru bozu dolls!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though we couldn't recreate the full course, I suggested renting the gymnasium to practice accelerating along the straightaways.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that keep the other girls
from using the gym, though...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I suggested inviting other Umamusume to train alongside them,
Rice Shower seemed relieved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the training session took place
and concluded successfully without any major hitches.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! 
If we make a lot of them, it's bound to clear up, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Let's make... a cute one, okay?
Rice thinks a blue teru teru bozu would be nice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If Rice does it, it might turn into an even bigger downpour. So...
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'll make plenty too.
Don't worry, I'll make a bunch too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's a relief, then!
Rice will do her absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps Rice Shower's wish got through, because the following day was blessed with magnificent clear skies.
